summary: The 40 pytest cases (25 F2P / 15 P2P) drive /app/sessions/bin/run-sessions and check live journal, open-session, JSONL, and catalog state for every material instruction and session-contract requirement. Hidden fixtures, config mutation, restart, and permutation checks are semantic; tests do not embed a callable end-to-end solver. Starter defects (mutate-before-parse CLI, tenant-blind keys, arrival-index gaps, watermark overwrite, seq rewrite) align with F2P names. Advisory LOW: two vacuous P2P asserts and empty-check desk refresh covered only on --input.

evidence.observation: Solver-visible work request names CLI, event-time sessions, journal restart, idempotent digests, empty/malformed handling, catalog desk files, warehouse preservation, and the binding contract path.

Binding contract specifies tie-break, feed order, reset-output, schemas, watermark formula and order, lateness, gap/duration/idle closes, catalog gap overlay, journal seq, and last_run/ops-report fields.
40 independent pytest functions with autouse runtime isolation; 25 F2P and 15 P2P; helpers only run the submitted CLI, parse JSONL, hash bytes, and COUNT click_event. No sessionizer reimplementation.
Creates /logs/verifier, initializes reward 0, runs pytest --ctrf on test_outputs.py, writes binary 1/0 after pytest; no installs and no trailing exit.
Digest-pinned Python 3.13 verifier image; bakes pytest pins from requirements.lock; copies test.sh, test_outputs.py, and hidden /tests/fixtures; does not copy solution/.
Starter touches/creates the journal and honors --reset-output against the journal before argparse, so unknown-flag, omit-source, empty-check, and reset-output F2P tests are discriminating.
Starter session_key discards tenant_id; tenant-isolation and holdout F2P tests would fail NOP.
Starter on-time path uses arrival_index*1000 when use_arrival_gap=True; gap-close and config-gap F2P tests require event-time ends.
Starter record() replaces max_observed instead of taking max, and pipeline records before classify; too-late, nondecreasing journal, and lateness-mutation F2P tests target that order bug.
Starter overwrites the journal with seq=1; seq, prefix-append, first-line formula, and restart F2P tests fail that behavior.
Starter already overlays enterprise session_gap_ms=45000 and leaves other catalog plans on processor.json; catalog overlay test is correctly P2P and still checks both sides.
Top-level artifacts=["/app/sessions"] with environment_mode=separate; verifier grades the transferred processor tree, not undeclared agent paths.
Packet-cited Harbor oracle job was not readable from this host/WSL; not used as a fail reason. F2P/P2P classification is from starter versus tests.
Packet-cited Harbor NOP job was not readable from this host/WSL; starter defects imply substantive F2P failures and reward 0.

findings.why_it_matters: test_p2p_config_keys reads processor.json after the autouse fixture always rewrites the three knobs, so it cannot fail even if the submitted tree dropped those keys.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: snapshot config keys before _write_config, or assert the on-disk shipped file in a path the fixture does not clobber.
findings.regression_risk: Low; gap/lateness/duration mutation tests already require the knobs to change behavior.

findings.why_it_matters: test_p2p_output_paths asserts SESSIONS.parent == ROOT/output using test constants, which cannot fail; only the empty-check exists() checks are behavioral.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: drop the tautological parent equalities or assert the CLI wrote those absolute paths after a non-empty run.
findings.regression_risk: Low; empty-check and side-output F2P tests already require the documented files.

findings.why_it_matters: last_run.json and ops-report.json catalog fields are asserted after --input, not after --empty-check, even though the contract calls empty-check a successful run that must rewrite those desk files.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: after --empty-check, assert the same warehouse.event_count / catalog.available / inventory.event_count fields against COUNT(click_event).
findings.regression_risk: Low; a natural shared finalize path already covered by the --input P2P test would still write both files.

do_not_change: Do not replace live run-sessions/journal/JSONL/catalog assertions with source greps or a callable sessionizer inside tests/.
Do not weaken F2P CLI, tenant isolation, event-time gap, watermark-order, journal seq, restart, holdout, or lateness-mutation checks to make NOP pass.
Do not drop the catalog overlay both-sides check, omit-source existing-file touch check, or reject-does-not-journal check.

REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.REQUIREMENT: Unknown flags or omitting --input/--feed/--empty-check exit 2 before touching journal, open-session state, or outputs (including --reset-output).
--input uses event-time tie-break: event_time_ms then (tenant_id, user_id, event_id) ascending, including equal-time permutation stability.
--feed keeps file/arrival order so out-of-order event times are preserved for lateness.
--reset-output may truncate sessions/late/rejects side files and must not clear the journal or in-flight sessions.
Sessions are event-time, keyed by (tenant_id, user_id), half-open, and must not merge across tenants for the same user_id.
On-time gap close uses last_event_time_ms + session_gap_ms as end_ms then opens a new session at event_time_ms; processor.json session_gap_ms is honored.
Max-duration close uses start_ms + max_session_duration_ms then opens a new session if the event is otherwise acceptable.
Watermark_ms = max_observed - allowed_lateness (raw, may be negative); journal one line per parsed observation with seq starting at 1; malformed lines do not journal; watermarks are non-decreasing.

Lateness uses the pre-update comparison watermark; late-but-allowed joins without lowering last_event_time_ms; too-late writes the contract late.jsonl schema; allowed_lateness_ms mutation changes classification.
Reload journal and open_sessions.json across process bounces; newly appended watermarks never step backward; in-gap events continue the restored session.
From a clean journal/open baseline, a second identical --reset-output run keeps SHA-256 digests of sessions.jsonl and late.jsonl.
--empty-check or zero-event input leaves sessions.jsonl and late.jsonl empty and does not advance the watermark journal.
Malformed JSON, missing fields, wrong types, empty ids, and negative event_time_ms fail closed into rejects.jsonl as REJECT_MALFORMED; empty payload is accepted; rejects are not late.
Each successful run rewrites last_run.json warehouse.event_count and ops-report.json catalog.available plus inventory.event_count from catalog.sqlite click_event.
Honor processor.json knobs; catalog enterprise tenants overlay session_gap_ms=45000; other catalog plans keep processor.json gap; non-catalog tenants keep processor.json.
Keep the Python processor and journal protocol; do not rewrite the binding contract to excuse wrong behavior; drive work through run-sessions.
Closed session records include tenant_id, user_id, start_ms, end_ms, event_ids, event_count with event_count == len(event_ids) and end_ms > start_ms.
After watermark update, close idle open sessions where last_event_time_ms + session_gap_ms <= W.
